args.title: Support rupee and other currency symbols in parseAmount
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Extend parseAmount to accept a leading rupee sign and similar currency symbols by adding them to the characters stripped out before parsing. This fixes the 'The amount is not a number' error for amounts with currency signs like `₹1,250.00` and `CHF 1'200.00`.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parseAmount function currently only strips out some currency symbols but not the rupee sign or the CHF sign with a space and apostrophe format. This causes 'The amount is not a number' errors when amounts with these signs are imported. The fix would extend parseAmount to handle these symbols correctly.
